cross_component_finding: This page is the strongest direct hit yet on the round's central hypothesis, in the OPPOSITE direction from a typical 'concept-docs is downstream of howtos' assumption: the promoted concepts/sdk/subdocument-operations.json file's own note says the concept was promoted from cloud/guides/reading-data.md, deleting-data.md and updating-data.md - explicitly NOT from 'the SDK's own reference page' - meaning sdk:subdocument-operations was promoted to the registry before either the Java SDK's concept-docs page (this one) or its howtos page (howtos/subdocument-operations.md, still unread as of this batch) had ever been extracted. This record supplies the first first-hand SDK-side definition for an already-promoted concept, confirming it describes the identical thing (atomic path-level get/upsert/replace/remove, network-efficiency framing) rather than a new distinction. It also produces the cleanest disambiguation relation in the batch: the page explicitly and directly states that Key-Value Sub-Document operations and 'Sub-Document SQL++ queries' are NOT the same thing, despite sharing the name 'sub-document' - a textbook shouldNotBeConfusedWith case, stated in the page's own words rather than inferred.
